activity_summary: Master Thwaite closed morning prayer. You stood in the south porch with the household. The close was still there. Sir John Spencer was in his pew, without the sword-bearer, and he did not speak to you. You said you were for home, with dinner and the garret, and no errand west. You left with them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was for home, and named no errand.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Closed the amen and took Alse out.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Gave the grace, and kept the house.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat in his pew, and did not speak.

entities.name: St Helen's
entities.context: Mentioned in The sand, and the close still there

facets.activity: Left the south porch and went home

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have no errand west today.
